text:
mika: idea thread  running a tiny A/B of battlecard headlines + webinar CTAs next week. want to test which message brings higher-quality infra/platform leads.

jules: sounds good. what are the axes?

mika: economics (cost/throughput) vs reliability (SLOs/fallbacks) vs portability (hosted -> private). also want to see CTA performance: Try demo vs Request dedicated.

harry: can we make the econ claim measurable but safe? e.g., "Teams have seen up to 3x lower serving cost with batching + cache (typical customer result)"

sam: yes, tag as "typical customer". add a small benchmark tile in the battlecard: p95/p99 latency ranges + tokens/sec + a note on batching impact.

mika: agree. i'll draft the battlecard lines: econ, portability, reliability. keep each 1-2 lines with a 1-line rebut for common competitor claims (cloud AI ops, managed API vendors, infra vendors).

jules: routing plan: econ -> /webinar-demo?utm=mk_econ (demo sandbox), reliability -> /webinar-enterprise?utm=mk_rel (contact form), portability -> /whitepaper?utm=mk_port. want to test form conversion + SQLs.

ops-bot: deploy task: MKG-8890 created. routes: /webinar-demo?utm=mk_econ and /webinar-enterprise?utm=mk_rel and /whitepaper?utm=mk_port. Staging previews at https://staging.redwood.test/mkg/8890

harry: creative ask: 2 headline variants per axis, 3 hero art comps, alt CTAs: "Try demo" / "Request dedicated" / "Download whitepaper".

sam: small Paid test on LinkedIn: econ ad + reliability ad. budget $1k. run Thu-Mon. capture utm + lead_type checkbox (hosted|dedicated|private).

jules: SDR flow: PLG demo signup -> immediate sandbox access + in-app tip to try batching recipe. Enterprise -> short 4-field form, auto-notify SDRs with lead tags.

mika: include short SDR rebut lines in the battlecard: cost -> "You don't need to own models to cut serving costs; runtime and cache do that." portability -> "Same API across deployments; minimal code changes." reliability -> "Auto-fallbacks, reserved pools, and SLA options." keep <2 sentences each.

legal-bot: flag: avoid absolutes & put benchmark phrasing as "typical customer results"; any % needs attribution. also review whitepaper claims for compliance.

mika: noted. will use soft language and include a one-line model parity note: "Matches open model quality; our differentiator is serving economics and operations."

harry: timeline: copy + headlines by Wed EOD, landing up Thu AM, ads live Thu. nick from design will mock hero images today.

sam: i'll set up analytics dashboard to report CTR -> MQL rate, and cost-per-qualified-lead. will share Monday AM.

jules: I'll slot a 20-min SDR prep call Fri to review rebut lines & routing.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: MKG-8890 deploy check Thu 09:15 UTC.

mika: awesome. i'll drop the draft battlecard in #marketing for quick review by Wed. :rocket:
